entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I hope you can help. I need to return something and I'm just so disappointed. I saved up for this.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To get started, could I get your name and order number?
Yes, it's Sarah Gable, order number VF78-9910. I've been a loyal customer for years, I just never have issues like this.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the Pro-Series jersey right here. I understand you're disappointed. To make sure I get you to the right solution, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the jersey?

It's the wrong size. I ordered my usual medium, but this new cut is... well, it's just too tight across the shoulders. I was so excited for my big ride this weekend, and now... I guess I can't wear it. It's a real letdown.

I can completely understand that feeling, especially when you're looking forward to using your new gear. It sounds like you'd be happy with the item if we could just get the fit right. Would you be interested in an exchange for a different size?
Yes, I think a large would work. Can I do an exchange? I really needed that money back if not, but I'd much rather have the jersey.

Absolutely. You are well within our 90-day return policy for apparel. We can certainly process an exchange for you. And Sarah, I see here you're one of our VIP members. As a thank you for your loyalty and to make up for the sizing issue, I'd like to process this return with a pre-paid label and I'll also put a rush on the new size being sent out to you with complimentary expedited shipping. How does that sound?
Oh! Really? That would be wonderful. I might actually get it in time for my next ride then. Thank you, Alex, that really turns this around for me.

You're very welcome. It's the least we can do. I have just processed the exchange. You will receive an email with your pre-paid return label in the next few minutes. Just drop the original jersey in the mail, and your new one is scheduled to ship out today. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you so much.
It was my pleasure, Sarah. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great ride.
